overall: The AG inferred the Board's members did not certify receipt of Open Meeting Law materials before September 2011, but found the Town had since taken adequate steps. It ordered certifications sent and future compliance; the complaint closes on receipt.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board, as appointing authority, failed to ensure that all Town boards and committees received Open Meeting Law materials, including the certification requirement.
allegations.key_passage: From Town Counsel's response, we infer that the Board's members also failed to comply with the Open Meeting Law's certification requirement prior to September 2011.

remedy: Within two weeks of receiving the determination, the Board must send the AG's office copies of completed Open Meeting Law certifications for all current Board members.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law is ordered.
remedy_passage: To confirm that it is currently in compliance, we order the Board, within two weeks of receiving this determination, to send our office copies of the completed certifications for all current members of the Board.
